goal: Revise Draft 2 to propose four CARE-informed questions as a universal workflow entry screen without redefining or displacing the CARE Principles and their continuing Indigenous Data Governance purpose; run three simulated review panels and edit in response.

actor.model: GPT-5-based Codex with three independent simulated agent review panels
actor.version: exact deployment versions not exposed to the repository

compute.environment: owner-authorized local Codex workspace with repository-scoped write access
compute.data_boundary: public repository content and public authoritative scholarly materials only; no research, governed, or sensitive data
compute.network: read-only access to the original Data Science Journal article and official Global Indigenous Data Alliance CARE materials for claim review; local loopback for website tests

instructions: PROMPT_LOG.md entry: Apply CARE as a baseline for every workflow
inputs: Carroll et al. 2020 and official GIDA CARE materials
three simulated agent panel reviews covering Indigenous Data Governance and ethics, Ecology, and agentic systems
outputs: revised Draft 2 manuscript and renewed claim-review fingerprints
regenerated reading PDF and Ecology formatting proof
synchronized README, project metadata, website, principle evidence maps, task template, decision, changelog, prompt, and provenance records
evaluations: three-panel simulated review with transparent limitations and editorial dispositions
Draft 2 citation-registry, fingerprint, placeholder, and section-word audit
full Python unit and governance test suite
Ecology structure test and visual inspection of all PDF pages
strict MkDocs build and Playwright website interaction tests
JSON, YAML, diff, and repository-state checks

human_review.reviewer: Ty Tuff plus required external scholarly and Indigenous Data Governance reviewers
human_review.notes: The three panels were simulated agent reviews and provide no Indigenous endorsement or human peer-review approval. Four explicit citation gaps remain. No publication or release action was taken.
